verdict.line: You lose the lane if you walk autos into Corrosive Charge and Echoing Flames range before you can close the gap; you win almost every fight you force once you're standing on top of him.

brief.thesis: Urgot is a ranged poke champion with an 800-range Q and a passive that punishes trading autos at distance, while Garen is a pure melee duelist whose only answer is to eat the poke and force point-blank fights. The 47.9% head-to-head over 1,429 games (against Garen's 50.7% baseline) reflects that Urgot wins the lane if he's allowed to kite freely, but Garen's short cooldowns mean he wins the lane the moment he's actually standing next to Urgot.

theirWindow.when: you're outside melee range of Urgot
theirWindow.what: Urgot's Q (Corrosive Charge) is an 800-range skillshot that damages and slows on explosion, and his passive (Echoing Flames) periodically adds extra flame damage to his autos and Purge — standing at range just lets him stack free damage on you. Use Q (Decisive Strike) the instant he lands Corrosive Charge to shed the slow and close distance instead of walking into the next one.

yourWindow.when: Urgot has used or whiffed E (Disdain)
yourWindow.what: Disdain is Urgot's only dash, with a 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s cooldown, and it's both his engage and his escape. The moment he burns it on you (or misses it), he has no tool left to disengage — commit immediately with E (Judgment) and W (Courage) rather than trading at range.

start.why: The 65.6%-picked start (48.1% win rate) gives the flat damage reduction on autos and sustain needed to survive Urgot's early Q/passive poke while you look for windows to close.

boots.why: Steelcaps post the higher win rate in this matchup (52% over 323 games vs Berserker's 49.2%) because Urgot's whole early kit — autos, Echoing Flames, Purge — is physical poke; flat auto-attack reduction directly counters it.

core.why: The highest-picked rushed item (21.5% in the top build path) — gives the stats and gap-close pressure Garen needs to actually reach a kiting ranged target.
Attack speed lets Garen's E (Judgment) ticks and autos punish Urgot once he's pinned in melee range, part of the 51% win rate Stridebreaker-into-Phantom Dancer path.
Caps the top 3-item path with grievous wounds, cutting into any self-healing Urgot picks up and securing kills once you're on top of him.

runes.keystoneWhy: Conqueror's stacking adaptive force and healing reward exactly the kind of extended melee fight Garen is trying to force on a ranged poke champion — the longer you're in his face, the more it heals back what Urgot's Q/passive chipped off.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 91.5% of games here (48.9% win rate) because Flash lets you force the all-in through Disdain's displacement or Corrosive Charge's slow, and Ignite closes out the trades Garen's kit is built to win once he's in range.

playing.title: Hold Q to break the slow
playing.detail: Decisive Strike cleanses all slows on cast, including Corrosive Charge's. Don't trinket-walk through the slow — Q through it and keep closing.

playing.title: Don't trade autos at range
playing.detail: Echoing Flames periodically adds bonus damage to Urgot's autos and Purge, so standing at the edge of his range and auto-trading just feeds him free poke. Only engage when you can commit to the full combo.

playing.title: Punish every Disdain whiff
playing.detail: Disdain is on a 16-14s cooldown and is Urgot's only dash. The second he misses it or uses it to disengage, he has nothing left — go all-in with E and W immediately.

playing.title: Expect Purge the instant he's hit you
playing.detail: Purge prioritizes champions Urgot has recently struck with other abilities and drops to near-zero cooldown at max rank (12/9/6/3/0s). After he lands Q or an E grab, assume immediate follow-up Purge damage and don't stand still in it.

playing.title: Save ultimate to end the fight, not start it
playing.detail: Demacian Justice's cooldown is 140/110/80/50/20s — at low rank it's too precious to use as poke. Hold it to execute once you've already won the extended trade in melee.

playing.title: Respect his ultimate once you're low
playing.detail: Fear Beyond Death has 2500 range and executes below a health threshold once it connects. Don't overextend on low health even if you're winning the lane — he can end the fight from off-screen.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, boots, runes, summoners, and win rates above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning and timing calls are my own analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Keep your distance from Urgot during early game to avoid being hit with his (P). Avoid his (E) when fighting him. Close in and use your skills off cooldown.
